identity.name: Gerald Heyward
identity.summary: Church drummer who became the R&B and pop stage's first-call player: Mary J. Blige and Beyoncé at the same time, Destiny's Child, Rob Thomas.

contribution.description: The "godfather" of the church drummers who took over R&B and pop stages (Modern Drummer, 2009): the first of that line to cross from gospel to R&B, and the one the next generation came up behind.
